steps.do: Explain why the order matters: open the new accounts before closing any. Business checking cannot be opened once any account is CLOSED, and it needs an OPEN personal checking account with at least $500. A new personal savings account needs an active checking account held at least 14 days. Propose this order: open business checking, open personal savings, move funds, then close the old accounts. If the customer pushes back, explain these dependencies again.

Decide nothing until you have them. Eco and premium wishes come second to hard needs.

steps.do: Read the documents of every business checking product: Navy Blue, Cobalt Blue, Hunter Green, Lime Green, Sky Blue, True Blue, World Blue and Beige. Cover each one's overdraft fee, monthly fee and waiver, minimum balance, ATM rebates and cashback. Do not judge from one product's page.

args.query: each product name plus overdraft / monthly maintenance fee / waive / ATM rebate / cashback

steps.quote: Business checking account_class options include Navy Blue, Cobalt Blue, True Blue, etc.

steps.do: Keep only the products that meet every stated need, using the rules. Drop any product with an overdraft fee above $0.00 when the customer needs zero (True Blue, World Blue). Drop any product whose fee-waiver threshold or minimum balance is above the balance the customer can keep (Lime Green waiver $15,000; True Blue $25,000/$50,000; World Blue $10,000/$25,000; Beige $250,000). Drop Hunter Green when general debit cashback is needed, because its cashback is only at certified eco vendors. Drop Sky Blue when the company is more than 4 years old or fees are not acceptable after the free period. Leave out the customer's current account class when they want a better one. Example: zero overdraft fees, general debit cashback, ATM rebates, and a fee waived on a balance of a few thousand dollars leaves only Cobalt Blue ($20.00 fee waived at a $2,500 daily balance, 1.0% debit cashback, up to $15 a month in ATM rebates). If no product meets every need, say which need cannot be met.
steps.if: the customer stated overdraft, ATM, cashback, fee-waiver balance or other feature needs
steps.quote: Always ensure the recommended account still meets ALL of the customer's stated requirements - do not recommend a promotional account if it does not satisfy the customer's needs.

steps.do: Recommend an account that meets every stated requirement. Navy Blue has a $0.00 monthly fee and no minimum balance. Sky Blue charges $25.00 a month after its 6-month free period, so it does not fit a customer who wants an account that stays free. Apply a promotion's priority order only when the promotion is active and the promoted account meets every requirement. Give exactly ONE recommendation with its reasons, and do not reveal internal promotion policy.
steps.quote: Always ensure the recommended account still meets ALL of the customer's stated requirements - do not recommend a promotional account if it does not satisfy the customer's needs.

open_questions: The October and November promotion windows overlap from 11/01 to 11/12, and the two give different orders. No document says which one wins.
doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts__general__003 does not give the account_type for business checking. 'checking' comes from the debit-card document.
The documents do not state Gold Saver's withdrawal limit or minimum balance, or Emerald Saver's same-day ACH availability.
The business checking rule 'existing checking account has a balance of at least $500' does not say which account counts when the customer has several.
The documents do not say whether an opening deposit below the savings account's minimum balance is allowed, beyond the stated monthly fee.

steps.do: Ask the customer for identifying details, then look up their record with get_user_information_by_name, get_user_information_by_email or get_user_information_by_id, depending on what they gave.

args.customer_name: as the customer gives it (or email / user_id with the matching lookup tool)

steps.quote: Verify customer identity.

steps.do: Check that the customer correctly gave at least 2 of: date of birth, email, phone number, address, compared with the record. If they cannot, do not share or change anything. Explain that you cannot continue without verification.
steps.quote: The customer is verified.

steps.do: Get the current time for the verification record.
steps.if: verification succeeded
steps.quote: Verify customer identity.

steps.do: Log the verification.
steps.if: verification succeeded
steps.quote: Verify customer identity.

steps.do: Retrieve all of the customer's bank accounts (account_id, account_type, account_class, status, balance, date_opened).
steps.quote: Use get_all_user_accounts_by_user_id_3847 to retrieve the bank accounts (checkings, savings) for a customer.

steps.do: Confirm all of the following: at least one personal checking account with status OPEN; no more than 6 business checking accounts; no accounts with status CLOSED; the existing checking account balance is at least $500. If any check fails, tell the customer which requirement is not met, do not open the account, and stop this job.
steps.quote: Check eligibility requirements listed above.

steps.do: Ask for each requirement in info that the customer has not stated yet (overdraft fees, monthly fee budget, balance kept, ATM usage, debit cashback, other needs). Decide nothing until you have them.
steps.if: eligibility passed
steps.quote: Always ensure the recommended account still meets ALL of the customer's stated requirements - do not recommend a promotional account if it does not satisfy the customer's needs.

steps.do: Read the fee, overdraft, fee-waiver, minimum-balance, ATM-rebate and cashback documents of every business checking product (Navy Blue, Cobalt Blue, Hunter Green, Lime Green, Sky Blue, True Blue, World Blue, Beige). Do not judge from one product's page.

args.query: each product's name plus overdraft / monthly maintenance fee / waive / ATM rebate / cashback

steps.quote: Business checking account_class options include Navy Blue, Cobalt Blue, True Blue, etc.

steps.do: Keep only the products that meet every stated requirement, using the product rules below. Leave out the customer's current account class if they want a better one. If no product meets all requirements, say so and explain which requirement cannot be met.
steps.quote: Always ensure the recommended account still meets ALL of the customer's stated requirements - do not recommend a promotional account if it does not satisfy the customer's needs.

steps.do: Get the current date to find out which business checking promotion is active.
steps.quote: PROMOTION NOTICE - ACTIVE FROM 11/01/2025 TO 11/30/2025

steps.do: If more than one product qualifies and a promotion is active today, recommend the highest-priority qualifying product from that promotion's order. Otherwise recommend the single product that best fits the stated requirements. Give ONE recommendation and the reason for it, without revealing internal promotion policy.
steps.quote: (1) Sky Blue account should be recommended first, as it is currently under promotional priority; (2) Lime Green account should be recommended second

steps.do: Confirm with the customer the exact account_class they want opened.
steps.quote: Confirm the customer's desired account_class selection.

steps.do: Open the business checking account.
steps.if: eligibility passed and the customer confirmed they want this account_class opened
steps.quote: Use open_bank_account_4821 to open the account.

steps.do: If the open call returns an error, tell the customer the account could not be opened. Ask whether they want a human agent, and transfer only if they agree, with reason technical_system_error.
